name: chrome-autofill-extension
description: Chrome extension para autocompletar formularios y OTP con Mailinator

scripts.version: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const cp=require('child_process');const path='manifest.json';const pkg=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('package.json','utf8'));const manifest=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path,'utf8'));manifest.version=pkg.version;fs.writeFileSync(path,JSON.stringify(manifest,null,2)+'\n');cp.execSync('git add manifest.json',{stdio:'inherit'});"
scripts.release:patch: npm version patch -m "chore(release): v%s" && git push origin main --follow-tags
scripts.release:minor: npm version minor -m "chore(release): v%s" && git push origin main --follow-tags
scripts.release:major: npm version major -m "chore(release): v%s" && git push origin main --follow-tags
